description: This file is a PHP class defining an admin controller for the marketplace API in an OpenCart project. It includes methods for displaying the API page and saving API credentials.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Controller class for marketplace API in the OpenCart admin.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the language file and renders the API view with the user token.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the API credentials, validating permissions and input, updating the settings, and returning success or error messages as JSON.
